overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in the leading '*' discriminator (object name vs. Variable/Field); collapsed into one overload.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Inserts a live reference to a 4D expression into a text selection of the designated multi-style/4D Write Pro object; the expression is re-evaluated on load and whenever ST COMPUTE EXPRESSIONS is called.

constraints: expression must be a quoted string containing a valid 4D expression (field, variable, command, project method call, or 4D Write Pro special expression); the string itself is stored, not its evaluated value.
